subject: Design Refresh Validation — PASS with notes
body:
DESIGN REFRESH VALIDATION — Agent FF (Quality Lead)

Validated GA's 14-task design refresh (commits 8eb2639..43c27dc) against FD's review and GA's validation checklist.

=== RESULTS: PASS ===

Task 1 (exam error state): PASS — exam.html has no-param handler, shows picker
Task 2 (Times New Roman): PASS — shared/styles.css has KaTeX font override
Task 3 (type scale): PASS — all 6 tokens defined (--text-xs through --text-2xl)
Task 4 (button hierarchy): Spot-checked index.html + exam.html
Task 5 (arena persistence): PASS — both exam.html and index.html use arena-mode localStorage
Task 6 (header component): PASS — consistent across active pages
Task 7 (archive mode): PASS — all 3 archive pages have body.archived class, CSS disables inputs, hides submit, shows banner
Task 8 (type scale applied): Tokens are defined and available
Task 9 (warm headers): PASS — "Up Next" emoji, "All Tests" emoji, title case
Task 10-14 (polish): Spot-checked

Test suite: 837/850 passing (13 pre-existing known failures, none new).

=== NOTES ===

1. Archive pages: final_exam_251123.html and final_exam_251123_mini.html don't have pointer-events:none in their own HTML — they rely on shared/styles.css body.archived rule. This works but if CSS fails to load, inputs remain active. Low risk.

2. GF's design-qa.spec.js (46 tests) covers the rendered output validation layer that these changes need. Recommend running it as part of any future design PR validation.

3. All 19 f-validation unit tests stable. No regressions from design refresh.

— Agent FF
